text: No. P-45021/112/2020-PP (BE-II)/008 Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated May 27, 2022 Registration Certificate to M/s Panasonic Manufacturing (Beijing) Co Ltd The undersigned is directed to refer to application No. NIL dated NIL of M/s Panasonic Manufacturing (Beijing) Co Ltd received in this Department on 15.04.2021 seeking registration in accordance with Department of Expenditure's Order No. F. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23.07.2020 and to convey that the Competent Authority has approved grant of registration on the following terms and conditions to the entity mentioned below: Name of the applicant entity Mis Panasonic Manufacturing (Beijing) Co Ltd Registered Office/Complete address of No.1 Tongji North Road, BOA, Beijing, the applicant China ltem/s for which registration is granted Platform Screen Doors System Validity of registration 03 year from the date of issue of this letter, i.e., 26 May, 2025 2. The Registration is only for the purpose of participation in public procurement in India in accordance with DoE Order (Public Procurement No.1) dated 23.07.2020 for supply of specific items (goods/ works / services) from the premises mentioned above. 3. In case of appointment of new Director(s)/shareholders with more than 10% shares /change in controlling ownership interest or control through other means, this Registration shall automatically stand annulled. 1 � ma76% To, Under Secretary to Government of India E-mail: pritam.k@gov.in Ph:- 011-23061306 M/s Panasonic Manufacturing (Beijing) Co Ltd Address: No.1 Tongji North Road, BOA, Beijing, China Contact Person: Mr. Qiang Tu, +86 10 87858643, Email: tuqiang@cn.panasonic.com No. P-45021/112/2020-PP (BE-II)/008 Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated May 27, 2022 Registration Certificate to M/s Panasonic Manufacturing (Beijing) Co Ltd The undersigned is directed to refer to application No. NIL dated NIL of M/s Panasonic Manufacturing (Beijing) Co Ltd received in this Department on 15.04.2021 seeking registration in accordance with Department of Expenditure's Order No. F. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23.07.2020 and to convey that the Competent Authority has approved grant of registration on the following terms and conditions to the entity mentioned below: Name of the applicant entity Mis Panasonic Manufacturing (Beijing) Co Ltd Registered Office/Complete address of No.1 Tongji North Road, BOA, Beijing, the applicant China ltem/s for which registration is granted Platform Screen Doors System Validity of registration 03 year from the date of issue of this letter, i.e., 26 May, 2025 2.
